ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

In the Laozi passage the paired adjectives are kept literal and parallel: «истинный / неистинный» (istinny / neistinny, 'true / not true') and «настоящий / ненастоящий» (nastoyashchy / nenastoyashchy, 'real / not real'), with «добродушие» (dobrodushiye, 'good-heartedness') and «приличие» (prilichiye, 'propriety'). «Благо личности» (blago lichnosti) is 'the good of personality', and the half-Slavonic «отдает душу свою за други своя» ('gives its soul for its friends') is translated plainly from Tolstoy's wording.
Source observation: [9] The attribution «Лao-Тсе» (Lao-Tse, 'Laozi') is typed in mixed script: the «ao» are Latin letters among Cyrillic ones, an encoding slip; the English reads 'Laozi.'
